verdict.rationale: The only bulk-related evidence is that the List Events API can be used for batch processing instead of webhooks. Other items show resources (account numbers, accounts per user) can be created programmatically, so bulk work is possible by scripting many individual calls through the API or CLI. There is no evidence of a native bulk or batch endpoint for acting on many items in one operation. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch write API (e.g., batch transfers or batch account creation), bulk actions in the dashboard or CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
